title: Acceptance probability at zero steps
statement: Let $N$ be a finite-state nondeterministic Turing machine on a Boolean input $x$, and let $C$ be a configuration on that input. The probability that a uniformly random choice word of length zero leads from $C$ to a halted configuration with output exactly $[\mathrm{true}]$ is $1$ if $C$ is already halted with output exactly $[\mathrm{true}]$, and is $0$ otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: C is a configuration of N on x
